hypothesis_title: ML Features Pool 보완 구축 — 800~1150 features (Daily Aggregate + Macro 확장 + Interaction/Lag/Rolling + 학술 신규)
hypothesis_description: 도훈 mandate Session 81 — ML 정식 리서치 cycle 진행 전 features pool 보완 구축. **현 base (WT-D20260514_007 inherit + Factor DB)**: 310 features (Factor DB 281 monthly + 007 신규 29). **Target**: 800~1,150 features (Kelly-Malamud-Zhou 2024 JoF Virtue of Complexity mandate 200+ × 4-5 overshoot). **Strict mandate: 사전 리서치, graduation gate 없음**. alpha_package.json 작성 X. 산출은 features_master.parquet + feature_registry.json + feature_quality_audit.json만. **보완 영역 (자율 진행)**: (1) **Daily-aggregate features ~30-32** (Andersen-Bollerslev-Diebold-Labys 2003 RFS Realized moments + Amihud 2002 illiquidity + max DD + winning days + autocorr + 52w high distance + run-length + VWAP deviation 가용 시), (2) **Factor DB Daily 309 monthly aggregate retrieve ~28** (현재 monthly 281만 사용, daily 309 중 monthly 미aggregate retrieve), (3) **Macro 확장 ~25-30** (FRED 15 series 전부 + KR ECOS 정책금리 / KRW-USD / KOR yield curve / KOSPI VIX 등), (4) **학술 신규 paper arxiv MCP ~5-15** (007 외 추가 method 발굴 — Bollerslev-Patton-Quaedvlieg 2024 realized higher moments / Easley-Lopez de Prado 2024 microstructure / 기타), (5) **Interaction terms top-K ~100-200** (Kelly Virtue 정통 — factor × factor / factor × sector / factor × regime), (6) **Lag features ~200** (1m/3m/6m/12m × top 50 base factors), (7) **Rolling statistics ~250** (mean/std/skew/kurt × 5 windows × top 50 base factors), (8) **Sector × top 5 + Regime × top 5 dummies ~50-100** (KR specific). **Skip 영역**: alt data (text NLP / ESG / global stocks / Google Trends / 뉴스 sentiment) — 도훈 mandate 정합. Factor DB 49 deprecated retrieve도 skip (data quality 이유). **산출 mandate**: (a) `stage_artifacts/WT_D20260514_008/features_master.parquet` — sig_date × Ticker × ~800-1150 features 단일 panel, (b) `stage_artifacts/WT_D20260514_008/feature_registry.json` — 각 feature metadata (source / 학술 인용 / PIT lag policy / family / variance / missing rate), (c) `stage_artifacts/WT_D20260514_008/feature_quality_audit.json` — 각 feature variance check / missing rate / cor matrix (cor>0.99 cluster 식별, screening 보조). **Universe**: KR_EQUITY_FULL_KOSPI_KOSDAQ_ALL_LIQ_2E8_FILTERED (WT-D20260514_003 universe expansion 학습 inherit, ~2,657 cover at 4/30). **Lineage source**: - Factor DB load_month_factors() 경유 (C15 정합), - WT-D20260514_007 5 panels inherit (`stage_artifacts/WT_D20260514_007/f1~f5_*.parquet`), - Factor DB Daily `.cache/factor_db_daily/` retrieve (daily 309 가용), - FRED `.cache/macro_fred.parquet` + KR ECOS 추가, - DART `.cache/dart/dart_raw_quarterly.parquet` (numeric metadata only, text NLP X). **PIT C1~C15 strict (필수)**: - C1 rolling/expanding only (full-sample 금지), - C2 monthly sig_date 기준 t-1 lag (daily features는 sig_date 직전 거래일 close), - C4 fundamental 45d lag (DART rcept_dt + 45d), - C9 vol/DD lag, - C11 FRED macro 1d/1m lag, - C13 Z_Score_Aligned only, - C14 Usable_Date ≤ sig_date, - C15 load_month_factors() 경유. **AX 정합**: AX-002 process honesty (full-sample 금지) + AX-001 v2 N/A (사전 리서치) + AX-005/007 N/A (alpha admit 안 함) + AX-008 N/A (사전 리서치 자원 구축만). **No Codex Round** (사전 리서치 단계, agent 자율 진행만 — 단 산출 후 quality audit 의무). **Time budget**: 자율 ~60-120분.
